thread:
Alex Nguyen: Quick sync — Nimbus Health renewal/expansion. They want to move from hosted -> committed hosted + Dedicated after POC. Need pricing guidance and PO timeline.
Maria Lopez: what's the exact ask from the customer?
Alex Nguyen: Current: hosted, ~60M tokens/mo. After POC they want to commit 200M tokens/mo for 12 months. Asking ~35% off list and Dedicated for p50 ~50ms. PO needed by Apr 5. They also asked for SOC2 attestation + EU data residency.
Tyler Brooks: 35% is above standard discount bands. We'll need deal desk approval. What's current list rate?
Alex Nguyen: current hosted list = $0.002/token. Rough math: 35% -> $0.00130/token. Dedicated is infra + premium; estimate add-on ~$15k/mo depending on pool size.
Emma Chen: POC passed perf/quality. They want a ramp schedule: month1 25%, month2 60%, month3 100%. Also requested 50k free tokens for the POC and a 30-day overage protection window during ramp.
Maria Lopez: to approve >25% discount we need RevOps + Dir Sales + Finance sign-off. Any deal >$250k ARR triggers SOW + security review.
Alex Nguyen: proposal idea: structured concession — base 20% for 200M commit, +10% for 12mo term, +5% for multi-year/advance payment. Offer 50k POC credit and 60-day overage protection.
Tyler Brooks: watch out — Dedicated infra costs will reduce room for discounts. Suggest dual-offer: (A) committed hosted @ $0.0016/token (with POC credits) or (B) hosted commit + Dedicated add-on: hosted @ $0.0018/token + Dedicated $15k/mo. Both options need deal desk for the deeper discount.
Emma Chen: customer prefers Dedicated but wants predictable unit price. Can we include an "overage cap" (max effective unit price during month1-2) to ease their ramp fears?
DealBot: deal flagged: requires deal_desk_approval. Tags: large_discount, security_review.
LegalBot: outstanding security items: SOC2 Type II report, Data Processing Addendum with EU residency clause, KMS/HSM requirements listed. Also need PO/LOI draft for legal review.
Maria Lopez: I'll open a formal deal desk ticket — need ARR estimate, margin impact, and the proposed pricing table. Alex, can you attach POC report + customer LOI?
Alex Nguyen: uploading POC report to S3: https://s3.company/nimbus/poc-report-2026-03-20.pdf ; asked customer for LOI, they'll try to get it by end of day. I'll draft the pricing table now.
Tyler Brooks: one more operational note: pricing engine enforces a floor. If the net unit price goes below floor, the platform auto-rejects checkout; manual override via deal desk is possible but we'll need finance sign-off.
Emma Chen: customer requested a freeze on model upgrades for first 6 months post-commit (to avoid drift). Can legal/ops sign off?
LegalBot: we can include a controlled upgrade clause in the SOW — legal will draft standard language but need exact duration and conditions.
Maria Lopez: timeline: I'll aim to get deal desk decision by Mar 30 if we have POC artifact + ARR and margin calc. If LOI arrives, we can pre-authorize pricing for LOI-sign stage.
Alex Nguyen: will prepare packet: usage run rate, POC metrics, proposed pricing table, LOI template, security checklist. Will ping here when uploaded.
Maria Lopez: perfect — thanks. Please @ me when packet uploaded. :pray:
